_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for test-suite routing (master plan 2026-07-02, L1). Lives in hub git @ main; mirrored ONE-WAY to Firestore console-config/suites by .github/workflows/mirror-suites.yml. The console reads the mirror (read-only); CI reads this file from its checkout. Edit HERE via PR — never in Firestore. Regenerate SUITES.md with: node scripts/gen-suites-doc.mjs

_fields.title/description: shown in the console Test Run dialog
_fields.config: the Playwright config the CI gate runs for this suite (already capture-appropriate)
_fields.capture: failure-only = screenshots/video only for failed tests (default) | all = every test (queue/journey owners' choice, L11)
_fields.specDir: spec root in this repo (run-isolated.sh SUITE_DIR)
_fields.appPaths: starlabs-angular globs — a branch diff matching any makes this suite MANDATORY
_fields.cfPaths: starlabs-cloud-function globs — same, for CF-side changes
_fields.areas: optional sub-routing within a suite: area name -> explicit spec list (run-isolated ONLY subset)
_fields.alwaysRun: true = baseline suite included in every routed run (none in v1; queue embeds its selftest baseline in each area list)
_fields.ciReady: false = local-only (no emulator config yet) — hidden from the console dialog
_fields.reviewNote: globs are a first draft — operator review pass pending (plan §7.4)

crossCutting._why: narrow map, broad fallback (preview-time-gate journal 2026-06-29): a match here can affect ANYTHING, so ALL ciReady suites become mandatory.
